svg.title: xPerfect deployment reference
svg.desc: Two supported ways to run xPerfect. On your computer, ./xperfect start serves the web interface, API and MCP on 127.0.0.1 for one person who unlocks it with a password; workers run as that user and state stays in a private folder with no storage limit by default. On a hosted server, packaged containers serve the web interface and MCP over HTTPS; people sign in with your identity provider, workers run in isolated containers and each person's files have a 5 GB quota by default. In both, saved work stays on the machine or server, while connected AI providers receive task content and tool results.

g.text: xPerfect / DEPLOYMENT REFERENCE
Your machine keeps the work. AI can be remote.
Two supported ways to run it • saved state and provider requests are different
ON YOUR COMPUTER
./xperfect start
One person, unlocked with a password
Web interface, API and MCP on 127.0.0.1
Workers run as your own user
Private state folder, no storage limit by default
HOSTED SERVER
Packaged containers, your identity provider
People sign in; only admitted people get in
Web interface and MCP over HTTPS
Workers run in isolated containers
Each person's files: 5 GB quota by default
Connected AI providers
Receive task content + tool results
Saved work stays on your machine or server.
Provider requests can leave it.
Check one real result and reload it before trusting either setup.
xPerfect runs on your computer or a server.
